name: Slides (Beamer)
description: A 16:9 Beamer talk: title slide, outline, step-by-step bullets, a two-column slide and a closing slide.
notes: `aspectratio=169` for modern screens. Remove it for 4:3.
`\item<2->` reveals an item from the 2nd click onwards. `\pause` is the quick alternative.
Navigation symbols are hidden because nobody uses them.
